### Alertmanager

**Categories:** Monitoring, metrics, logs and tracing, SRE, incident response and on-call<br>
**Roles:** Observability Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, DevOps Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Active

Prometheus component that deduplicates, groups, silences, and routes alerts to notification receivers.

**Use when**

**Consider alternatives when**

- You require a complete on-call scheduling and incident-management platform.
